# Universal Web Foundation

Start with AGENTS.md and FOUNDATION_MANIFEST.yaml. UWF is a Foundation-first planning and governance workspace for web projects. Application code is prohibited until the relevant implementation gate is approved.

Documentation:
- README.md — human installation and overview
- Foundation/README.md — Foundation stage map
- Foundation/00-Control — questions, decisions, risks, and change records
- templates/ — reusable specifications and review formats
- docs/ — beginner, professional, automation, and migration guides
